fee_notes: Royalty is 5% of monthly Net Sales (not Gross Sales); may be adjusted up or down per Note 3 based on location type, new market, incentive programs, or franchisee experience. Advertising Fee is 5% of monthly Net Sales for locations outside the LA DMA, or 4% for locations within the LA DMA (may increase up to 1% above original rate in LA DMA with 90 days notice). Tech fee of $1,050.25/month (Platinum IT Support Agreement for Oracle Micros POS); also an annual Oracle Micros POS Software Support fee of up to $2,700. Remote Ordering (Olo) fee: 1.3% of Gross Sales per order. Loyalty Program (Loco Rewards): Delivery 1.35% of Gross Sales + $0.50/order; Pickup 1.35% of Gross Sales. Third-Party Delivery fees range from 15%–24% of Gross Sales (platform-dependent) plus Olo 1.35%. Intranet fee up to $2,000/year per restaurant; Franchisee Page fee up to $1,000/year per restaurant. Learning Management System: $19/month per restaurant. Security Services: $600/year. Indoor Digital Menu Board: $19/month per menu panel (standard 4-panel board). Outdoor OCB: $19/month. Kiosk (optional): $1,450/unit/year. Obsolete Inventory Fund: $0.18/case on vendor invoice price for whole birds and saddles. Market Study/Impact Analysis: $5,000–$12,000 each. Transfer fees: 40% of current Initial Fee (new franchisees), 25% (existing franchisees), $10,000 (developers); Entity/Trust Transfer Admin Fee: $500; New Principal Admin Fee: $2,500/new principal. Successor Fee: 50% of then-current standard Initial Franchise Fee. Early Termination Fee: average monthly Royalty + Advertising Fees for preceding 48 months × lesser of remaining months or 24 months. Remodel Admin Fee: $5,000; Refresh Admin Fee: $2,500.

Royalty (See Notes 1, 2 & 3). | 5% of monthly Net Sales for all products sold at the Restaurant. | On the 10th day after the end of each sales month. | Net Sales is defined in Note 2 below; see also Note 3 for possible reductions or increases in Royalty.
Advertising Fee (See Notes 1, 2, 3 & 4). | 5% of monthly Net Sales (or 4% of monthly Net Sales for Los Angeles ("LA") DMA, as defined by Nielsen Media Research, Inc. per the US Cities by Designated Market Areas Report). | Same as Royalty. | See Note 4 for possible increases in the LA DMA Advertising Fee.
Computer systems maintenance and support (Notes 1 & 11). | Will vary under the circumstances (See Note 11). | On the 10th day after the end of each sales month. | See Note 11. [Note 11 specifies Platinum service monthly fees per Restaurant will be $1,050.25]
Remote Ordering (See Notes 2 & 14). | 1.3% of Gross Sales per order. | As incurred.
Loyalty Program ("Loco Rewards") (See Notes 2 & 17). | Delivery – 1.35% of Gross Sales per order plus $0.50 per order. Pickup – 1.35% of Gross Sales per order. | As incurred.
Learning Management System (See Note 22) | Currently $19 per month per Restaurant | On the 10th day after the end of each sales month.
Security Services (See Note 23). | Security tools and services are $600 per year. | As incurred.
Intranet Fee (See Notes 1 & 12). | If Intranet is established, reasonable cost up to $2,000 annually per Restaurant (max. increased by 3% per annum during term).
Franchisee Page Fee (See Notes 1 & 13). | If Franchisee Page is established, reasonable cost up to $1,000 annually per Restaurant (max. increased by 3% per annum during term).
Indoor Digital Menu Board – Dining Room (See Note 20). | Fees are $19 per menu panel and the standard indoor digital menu board and preview board display consists of 4 menu panels.
Kiosk (See Note 21) | Optional; Recurring Fees are currently $1,450 per unit per year.
Outdoor Order Confirmation Board (OCB)(See Note 27) | Fees are $19 per month for the outdoor OCB display.
Obsolete Inventory Fund (See Note 8). | Additional $0.18 per case on vendor's invoice price of both whole birds and saddles. | As incurred.
Remodel Administrative Fee | $5,000.00
Refresh Administrative Fee | $2,500.00
Early Termination Fee | The average monthly Royalty and Advertising Fees paid for the preceding 48-month period immediately preceding the date we received notification of the closure, multiplied by the lesser of (i) the number of months remaining in the term of Franchise Agreement or (ii) 24 months.
